THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Air Fryer Chicken Thighs + Cheesy Broccoli

This is the recipe that proves 'chicken and broccoli' doesn't have to be sad. Dan-O's Cheesoning on hot broccoli changes everything. Same cook, different plates — kids get comfort, adults get flavor. Two air fryers running at once makes the two-seasoning split trivial — but any air fryer with enough separated capacity works.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIME25 min
COOK METHODAir fryer
EST. / SERVING~380 cal | ~42g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: Pat chicken DRY before seasoning — moisture kills crispness in the air fryer.

Ingredients

PROTEIN

  • 6 chicken thighs (boneless, skinless — 4 adult, 2 kid)
  • Avocado oil spray

ADULT SEASONING

  • Dan-O's Outlaw Blackened Bloody Mary
  • Extra Cheesoning

Option B — Deconstructed

  • Ketchup or mild dipping sauce on side

VEG

  • 12 oz frozen broccoli florets (do not thaw)
  • Avocado oil spray
  • Salt
  • Dan-O's Cheesoning (for finishing)

Option A — Full Plate

  • Dan-O's Original + salt (mild)
  • 1 small dinner roll OR preferred bread per kid

Allergens: dairy.

STOP. Chicken and broccoli are done. Plate differently — adults get bold seasoning + extra veg, kids get mild + dinner roll.

Method

Shared base

  1. 1.DIVIDE + DRY. Pat all 6 thighs completely dry. Divide 4 thighs into the adult bowl and 2 into the kid bowl.
  2. 2.SEASON SPLIT. Season the 2 kid thighs with Dan-O's Original (mild). Season the 4 adult thighs with Outlaw Blackened Bloody Mary (bold). Light avocado oil spray on both portions, toss.
  3. 3.REST. Cover both bowls and refrigerate a couple of hours so the seasoning grabs.
  4. 4.PREP BROCCOLI. Toss 12 oz frozen broccoli with light avocado oil spray + salt. Do NOT thaw. Cheesoning goes on AFTER cooking, not before.
  5. 5.LOAD BOTH AIR FRYERS. Mild thighs in one basket, blackened thighs in the other (or use one basket with a divider). Broccoli goes in a third basket / vessel. Two-air-fryer setup is the personal favorite here — but any air fryer with enough separated capacity works.
  6. 6.COOK CHICKEN. 375°F, 20 min, flip halfway. Verify 165°F internal on the thickest piece.
  7. 7.COOK BROCCOLI. 400°F, 15 min, shake / toss halfway. Goal: crispy charred edges.
  8. 8.CHEESONING FINISH. Immediately sprinkle Dan-O's Cheesoning on hot broccoli. Toss while hot — this is the differentiator.

Adult — Bold + High Protein

  1. 9.SLICE + PLATE. Slice 2 blackened thighs per adult. Add one-quarter of the cheesy broccoli. No bread on the adult plate.

Kid Plate — Comfort + Familiar · Option A — Full Plate

  1. 9.CHOP + PLATE. Chop 1 mild thigh per kid. Add one-quarter of the broccoli and one small roll (or preferred bread).
  2. 10.SERVE. Two split plates — mild kid + bold adult, both from the same cook.

Kid Plate — Comfort + Familiar · Option B — Deconstructed

  1. 9.PLATE. Cubed chicken + broccoli on side (not mixed) + roll. Dipping sauce optional.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult — Bold + High Protein: Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid Plate — Comfort + Familiar: Serve the kid portion as described above.

Keys to success

  • Don't overcrowd broccoli — single layer or it steams instead of crisps.
  • Add Cheesoning IMMEDIATELY when broccoli comes out — it needs the heat to stick.

If something fails

Chicken isn't crispy on the outside: You didn't pat it dry. Also check you used oil spray — it needs a thin fat layer for browning.

Broccoli is soggy / steamed: Overcrowded the basket. Do two batches if needed. Single layer is non-negotiable.

Cheesoning didn't stick: You waited too long. Sprinkle within 30 seconds of pulling from the air fryer while it's still hot.

Chicken overcooked / dry: Thighs are forgiving but check at 16 min. Pull at 165°F internal — carryover does the rest.

Storage and reheating

Store: Store chicken and broccoli separately. Chicken reheats well, broccoli loses some crunch.

Reheat: Air fryer 350°F for 3-4 min to re-crisp. Microwave works for chicken but kills broccoli texture.

Lasts: 3-4 days in fridge.

Estimated nutrition

~380 cal | ~42g protein.
